fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: After learning this program, students can deal with related complicated engineering problems individually. Students are trained to obtain the ability to solve complex environmental engineering problems, especially in the field of mining and metallurgy industry, such as sewage treatment, air pollution control, solid waste recycling and other aspects of engineering problems. ​ 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Please be noted that the listed courses may change according to adjustment every year. Chinese, Overview of China, Microbiology for Environmental Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Water Pollution Control Engineering, Air Pollution Control Engineering, Solid Waste Treatment And Disposal, Environmental Planning and Management, Environmental Monitoring. 3. Introduction of University of Science and Technology Beijing Editor Notes: As a university of "firsts", USTB continually strives to be a leading innovator in both China and the global community. The University of Science and Technology Beijing (USTB) was founded in 1952 following the amalgamation of the best departments in related fields of five eminent universities as a result of a nationwide reorganization of the higher education system. USTB values greatly and will forever cherish its long tradition of being "Rigorous in Learning and Research and Venerating Practice". Over 100,000 graduates are contributing to society all over the world; most of them have become professionals and joined our national elites in the field of politics, economics, science and education. As metallurgy and materials science are the two disciplines for which it is most renowned, USTB is also known as "the cradle of iron and steel engineers". Learn More>> 4. About International Student Center Editor Notes: International Student Center are responsible for all international students' affairs. USTB International Student Center, which takes charge of making overall plan in development of international student education, management and coordination in students affairs, has four divisions: integrated office, office of recruitment and programs, office of students affairs, and foreign language teaching center. In July 2013, USTB has been approved by the Ministry of Education to be one of the first "Demonstration Base of Studying in China". Every year, the International Student Center will provide a rich variety of colorful internship and extra-curriculum activities for international students. They have the chance to pay a visit to industrial and commercial enterprises, to the scenery spots such as Forbidden City and the Great Wall; they can also participate in singing, dancing, painting, calligraphy competitions, "Star of Chinese" competition, Chinese debate competitions, as well as sport competitions and New Year parties. 5. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Calligraphy ​​ Making Bread ​​​Laoshe Tea House ​​​

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 2. One Photocopy of Passport (Ordinary Passport) With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 3. Graduation Certificates (high school), must be Original of Notarized in Chinese or English * 4. Official Transcripts up to the present, including courses taken and standard achieved, must be Original of Notarized in Chinese or English. * 5. Certification of no criminal record 6. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 7. Letter of Financial Guarantee You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Health Certificate You can download a template or sample from here . 9. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport, in good physical and mental health, with good conduct, appropriate academic qualifications, and proficiency in the required language. 2.For undergraduate programs, applicants should generally be 35 years old or younger, hold a high school diploma, and pass the Chinese Standardized Test for Undergraduate Admission of International Students (CSCA). 3.CSCA requirements a) Chinese-language subject transcript (for Chinese-taught programs): (1) Liberal Arts (Chinese): English, Japanese, German, Public Administration, Social Work, Law, Accounting, International Economy and Trade, Financial Engineering, Big Data Management and Application, Information Management and Information Systems, Visual Communication Design. (2) Science and Engineering (Chinese): All other undergraduate programs. b) Mathematics transcript: Required for all programs. Exams are in Chinese except for Environmental Engineering and Materials Science and Engineering (English-taught exams). c) Physics or Chemistry transcript: Required for science, engineering, and agriculture-related programs (choose one subject).
